Cushioned Dog Harness

Comfy & Cushioned: Performance materials for supreme comfort
3 Leash-Attachment Points: Maximum flexibility and control
Simple & Secure: Quick-snap buckles for easy on and off
Description

Our most elevated, versatile, and ultra-comfortable dog harness. 

Soft, stretchy, double-layer neoprene cushions the body for all-day wear and adapts to different walking styles. Features three leash attachment points to suit different walking styles: front for anti-pull control, and upper and lower back for more relaxed walkers. Adjustable straps at the neck, chest, and back create a customized fit, while quick-release buckles at both the neck and chest make on-and-off more effortless.

Premium finishes and thoughtful craftsmanship deliver the perfect balance of comfort, performance, and style for dog parents who want the very best.

Product Details

Materials
Soft stretch poly base, woven nylon straps, and coated carbon steel D-rings

Product Dimensions & Specs
XS: Neck = 10"-11", Chest = 13"-16"
S: Neck = 12"-14", Chest = 16"-22"
M: Neck = 15"-18", Chest = 20"-28"
L: Neck = 17"-22", Chest = 26"-38"

More measurement details are provided in the sizing guide linked above.

Care & Caution

Caution Notice
All of the dyes used in our products are pet safe. For some of our more vibrant colors, the dye can transfer to lighter-colored pet coats. We recommend hand-washing your Harness before the first use with mild soap and warm water, then air drying flat.

Cleaning Instructions
Hand wash using mild soap and warm water (recommended method). Alternatively, the Harness can be machine washed on the delicate cycle, though slight pilling may result from this method. Always air dry.

Product FAQs
Does the Harness work well with puppies?

Our Harness is great for puppies. It's comfortable for lively playtime and impromptu naptime. We do recommend sizing up, as pups can outgrow their walk gear as they get older and grow into their adult body.

Does the Harness help to reduce pulling?

Yes! Our Harness has three leash-attachment points, 1 in the front and 2 in the back, because we all lead in different ways. The front attachment is useful for reducing pulling while on walks.

Should I use a Collar or a Harness for my dog?

Experts recommend Collars for everyday wear, however, a Harness is the safest option for going on walks and engaging in outdoor activities.

What makes the Harness comfortable for dogs?

Our Harness is made from a cushioned, light-weight material, that includes some performance fabric stretch. This ensures your pup has room to move, while staying secure.

Which leash attachment should I use for my dog, front or back?

This all depends on your dog's walk style. The front attachment is best for dogs who pull, as it can minimize their freedom to charge ahead. The back clip is slightly more versatile, and recommended for dogs who are trained to walk with their pet parent.

Shipping & Returns

Shipping
We offer free standard shipping on all domestic orders of $90 and above! Nothing stands between you and your order except 5-9 business days. Need it sooner? We got you. Just select Expedited shipping at checkout for delivery in 2–4 business days.

Returns
Items may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery if they have not been used. Products may be carefully tried on to confirm fit, but items that have been used outdoors, soiled, damaged, or show signs of use beyond try-on are not eligible for return or exchange.

Start your return or exchange through our Online Return Portal.

Orders with Shipping Protection include a prepaid return shipping label. For orders without Shipping Protection, the cost of the return shipping label will be deducted from your refund.

Items discounted 40% or more are final sale and not eligible for returns or exchanges.

Personalization
Personalized items are made to order and cannot be returned or exchanged. Adding personalization can take up to an additional 2 business days to process.

Sizing Tips

1. Don't have a soft tape measure? Use a piece of string or rope and measure the string with a ruler as you go.

2. For growing puppies or dogs with extra thick coats, we recommend adding a little extra space (3 fingers) when measuring. 

3. In between sizes? Our recommendation is to size up!
